families.description: Thread 1 holds lock A and waits for B; thread 2 holds B and waits for A.
Three threads, three locks: A waits for B, B for C, C for A.
N philosophers each take the left fork, then wait for the right one.
A condition-variable signal is sent before the waiter waits, and the waiter has no predicate.
The producer never signals the last item; consumers sleep forever.
A barrier sized for N threads, but one thread leaves early.
Workers wait on a semaphore whose poster exits before posting.
16 threads keep one mutex about 90% busy; most are blocked in futex at any moment.
One thread holds a lock for 1-2.5 s of real work while the others wait.
Many locks, always taken in one global order: no cycle is possible.
All threads sleep 1-2 s in nanosleep between two work phases.
The same producer-consumer, with a predicate loop and a signal per item.
Readers block in read() on a pipe whose writer pauses for 1-2 s.
